messages:
tay: deploy-bot flagged a stability regression in ap-south after the 2.8.0 rollout. p95 doubled for /embed.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: route=/embed region=ap-south p95 > threshold for 4m. recommendation: MANUAL_ROLLBACK to 2.7.5, staged. auto_revert: ON
mira: we have a scheduled partner job in ap-south tonight. auto revert could break them. can we flip auto_revert off for that region?
ops-oncall: I can flip it off and do a manual staged rollback. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with smoke evals.
tay: logs show it's latency tail, not 5xx. snippet: ```2026-03-23T22:01:12Z p95=512ms route=/embed model=embedx kernel=fastpath```
devrel: pinging partner success to warn about potential change if we hit 100%.
ops-oncall: turning off auto-revert: `deployctl set-auto-revert --region ap-south --off --id 2026-03-23-280`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: auto_revert_disabled id=280 region=ap-south status=ack
ops-oncall: starting staged rollback 5%: `infractl pin --route /embed --version 2.7.5 --region ap-south --slice 5 --reason "p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1781009999-1
mira: running smoke eval set "embed_smoke_ap" now
devrel: partner notified, they will monitor jobs.
ops-oncall: 5% stable after 6m, p95 improved ~40%. moving to 25%
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1781009999-2
mira: eval: latency_ok=true, quality_ok=true
ops-oncall: moving to 100% now
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1781009999-3
tay: posted quick incident blurb: "Staged rollback in ap-south for /embed due to p95 regression after 2.8.0. Monitoring."
ops-oncall: pin applied; monitoring. will open INF ticket for postmortem and update release notes.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1781009999-3 status=success
ops-oncall: INF ticket INF-2026-460 created. marking thread resolved."
